Additional note:
  • Animations of emotes

The term emote refers to a cosmetic feature that provides no functional benefits to the hero. All available cosmetic emotes are obtainable only by the purchasing of DLC packs and equipable from the Cosmetics page of the inventory. They can be obtained in Seasonal Adventures.

Emotes

"MCD:Cloud Watcher" redirects here. For the hero skin, see Dungeons:Cloudwatcher.

Emotes are actions that the hero can perform when idle. Every one of them has the hero, Hal, in the main image.

History

Minecraft Dungeons
October 16, 2021 In a twitter post, new Pet, Flair, emotes, and new heroes were announced on Minecraft Live.[1]
November 2, 2021 A video released on Twitter introduced emotes, describing dancing, dramatic posing, and imitating endermen. The twitter post also revealed that emotes will be added to the game next month as part of Cloudy Climb, the first seasonal adventure.[2]
November 29, 2021 A video released on Twitter introduced The Pickaxe emote, revealing it to be part of the premium reward track.[3]
1.12.0.0 Added the Hero Pose, Enderman, Ironic Dance, Stylish Spins, Dramatic Fall, and Workout emotes.
Emotes are now unlockable in-game through the Cloudy Climb Seasonal Adventure's reward tracks, both free and premium.
